LESSON: INTRODUCTION TO DRAWING

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
Strand: Communication in Pre-Technical Studies
Topic 2.1: Introduction to Drawing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Introduction to Drawing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: How are drawings used in technical communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
2. draw types of lines used in drawing
3. appreciate the role of drawing in communication
4. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: INTRODUCTION TO DRAWING
This lesson teaches Introduction to Drawing for Grade 7 PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES.

STUDY STEPS
1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. draw types of lines used in drawing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of drawing in communication
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
4. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Introduction to Drawing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Introduction to Drawing above.
2. Explain Introduction to Drawing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Introduction to Drawing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Introduction to Drawing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Introduction to Drawing important for a Grade 7 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. How are drawings used in technical communication?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. explain the importance of drawing as a means of communication
2. draw types of lines used in drawing
3. appreciate the role of drawing in communication
4. used in drawing • use audio-visual aids to study the application of symbols and abbreviations in drawing

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
